# Monocypher

Unmodified sources from Monocypher 4.0.3, commit
`ab2b16dd619ad5f6979a4fbe69cfa324a6fcc35f`:
https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher/tree/ab2b16dd619ad5f6979a4fbe69cfa324a6fcc35f

The optional Ed25519 unit implements RFC 8032 Ed25519 with SHA-512. The main
unit supplies shared field/scalar primitives. Function/data sections and linker
garbage collection omit unused algorithms. This project selects the BSD-2-Clause
license option; retain the original file notices and licenses/monocypher-LICENCE.md.
